main.description: Whether a domain is ready to be the group's handle: what its _atproto DNS record, or its /.well-known/atproto-did, names now. Changes nothing. Requires group.configure.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

handle.description: The domain to check, such as riders.org.
The domain, as the host reads it: lower case, with no @.

ready.description: Whether updateGroupHandle would take it now: the domain names this group, or it is the group's own address.

did.description: The DID the domain names now, if any: another one means its record is wrong.
